aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.subtitle: My Story and Trajectory in Basketball

hero.title: My Story
hero.paragraph1: I was born in the city of Concepción, Chile, and grew up in a family where basketball was part of everyday life. My older brothers played, and from a young age the sport surrounded me: the ball, the court, and the daily rhythm of training were always present.
hero.paragraph2: At 14, I was recruited by Club Petrox Chile. Looking back, it marked the beginning of a journey that allowed me to grow as a player, coach, and mentor. Since then, basketball has been the foundation of my personal and professional development.
hero.paragraph3: Over time, my experience as a player naturally evolved into a passion for coaching, leadership, and long-term athlete development, always with a strong focus on the formative process.

biography.title: About Me
biography.paragraph1: My mission is to guide the new generations on their basketball journey, providing them with technical, mental, and emotional tools so they can grow as athletes.
biography.paragraph2: With over XX years of experience training youth, my focus is on holistic development: teaching solid fundamentals, cultivating passion for the game, and fostering values that transcend the court.
biography.paragraph3: I have had the privilege of working with world leaders, elite athletes, successful entrepreneurs, and millions of people seeking to create significant changes in their lives.

timeline.title: A Look at My Professional Journey over time

events.title: Basketball Beginnings
events.description: At age 14, I was recruited by Club Petrox Chile, standing out as one of the country’s most promising youth basketball talents.

events.title: Professional Debut
events.description: I made my debut with the senior team of Club Petrox Chile, beginning an 18-season professional basketball career in Chile.

events.title: Professional Playing Career
events.description: I won four national league championships and was named Best Player in three consecutive finals. I also represented the Chilean national team from age 16 to 27.

events.title: Coaching Beginnings
events.description: I began my coaching career at Colegio Marista de Los Andes.

events.title: U17 National Champion
events.description: As a coach, I won the U17 National Championship with Club Arturo Prat de San Felipe.

events.title: U17 South American in Argentina
events.description: I joined the coaching staff of the Chilean U17 national team at the South American Championship in Argentina, qualifying for the FIBA Americas U18 Pre-World Cup.

events.title: Domani Champion
events.description: As a coach, I won the Campioni del Domani U19 title with Club Arturo Prat, Chile’s most important youth basketball tournament.

events.title: U17 South American Title
events.description: I served as Head Coach of the Chilean U17 national team at the South American Championship in Lima, Peru, achieving a historic title: Chile’s first South American championship in this category. The team qualified for the 2018 FIBA Americas U18 Pre-World Cup

events.title: National League Second Division Final
events.description: I led Club Arturo Prat’s senior team to the National Second Division League final.

events.title: Founding of Trasandino Basket
events.description: I founded Trasandino Basket in Los Andes, a player development program that now serves over 100 athletes with a solid coaching staff.

events.title: IBT Camps Begin in Orlando
events.description: Although the IBT (International Basketball Training) camp already existed in Florida, 2018 marked the first time I led a group of Chilean players to take part in this international experience. Since then, I have continued to lead this initiative year after year, providing young talents with the opportunity to train with American coaches, compete internationally, visit universities, and broaden their basketball perspective. This program has become an active bridge between Chile and the United States, opening new opportunities for both athletic and personal development.

events.title: FIBA Americas U18 Pre-World Cup in Canada
events.description: As a coach, I led the Chilean U18 national team at the FIBA Americas Pre-World Cup in Canada, finishing the tournament with Chile ranked within the global youth basketball standings (#34).

events.title: Final with Club Sergio Ceppi
events.description: I reached the National Second Division League final once again, this time as head coach of Club Sergio Ceppi in Santiago.

events.title: Head Coach at Stadio Italiano
events.description: I served as Head Coach of Stadio Italiano in Las Condes, leading the club’s sports projects and youth development programs.

events.title: International Career in the USA
events.description: I joined The Academy of Central Florida in Orlando as a coach and international recruiter, focusing on youth development and building basketball pathways between Chile and the United States.
